entities.summary:
Mohammad Jamshidi Jafarabadi, known more simple as Mohammad Jamshidi, is an Iranian professional basketball player who is playing 
for the Mahram Tehran in the Iranian Super League. A 6'6" swingman, he is also a member of the Iranian men's national basketball team.
